name: terse
description: Three skills you invoke to assess and improve any text: a README, code comments, an essay. `audit` finds where readers stumble and checks each claim against the code or facts behind it. `rethink` agrees what the text says and in what order before it is written. `rewrite` writes it: one writer who first works out who reads it, every critic at once, one repair and a check. Nothing touches your files without your word.
